messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Write a practical notice for a fictional seed library: borrowers may take two packets, record the variety, and return seeds after harvest only if they can verify the variety. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: Seed Library Notice: Borrowers may take up to two seed packets per visit. Please record the variety name in the logbook. After harvest, return seeds only if you can verify the variety was not cross-pollinated and remains true to type. Unverified seeds cannot be accepted, as they may compromise our collection. Thank you for helping keep our library reliable and abundant for all growers.
